title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
description_en: arXiv:2611.00172v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Embedding models underpin virtually every modern AI system, from search engines to recommendation systems. Despite shared mathematical foundations, research on embedding models remains fragmented by modality: the communities develop largely in isolation, seldom exchanging insights. We argue that this fragmentation obscures a deeper convergence. Driven by contrastive learning, Transformer architectures, and a granularity shift, embedding research across modalities is converging toward a common set of principles, even as modality-specific challenges remain underexplored. To reason across this convergence without conflating it, we propose a framework of three progressively harder capabilities: coverage, comparability, and compositionality. Three

title: AgentKit by Scalekit
description_en: MCP gateway for production agents that acts on your behalf. Let your agents use 30,000+ tools across 600+ apps, from Salesforce to GitHub, through one MCP gateway. AgentKit handles auth and integrations, so every action runs as the user who asked, within the scopes they granted. Give each agent only the tools its job needs with Virtual MCP Servers. Add internal APIs as custom connectors. Use Triggers to start an agent the moment an email lands. Built for developers taking agents to production: every call is logged. Free tier: 10,000 tool calls a month.

title: Teamily AI
description_en: Your personal agent, agent teams & people in one messenger. The human-agent platform where people and always-on agents get work done together in one unified, context-aware space. Unlike single-user personal agents, Teamily AI enables multi-user, multi-agent teamwork. Built on an AI-native messenger, it connects people, agents, docs, meetings, calls, workflows, and business systems to automate office work and customer service. Agents become real teammates with persistent memory, proactive intelligence, and continuous self-improvement. Free to get started.

title: Wanaka Studio
description_en: Make and publish 3D games with the first AI game engine. The first all-in-one, AI-native game engine. An AI agent builds your AAA-style 3D game. You can edit it directly in a synced visual editor. No code. Auto-rigging, multiplayer, and 1-click publish built in. Uses ~80% fewer tokens and generates faster than Claude Opus 5.5 + Unity.

title: Testifly
description_en: Autonomous AI QA. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. . CTOs and founders with small teams and no time or resources to test and maintain. Connect your web app and Testifly does the rest. Discovers flows, writes tests, self-heals, explains failures with video. Zero prompting. Zero maintenance. 30-day free trial.

title: Floot Payments
description_en: Take payments in apps you build in ChatGPT and Claude. Floot apps can now take real money. Ask your AI in ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor for "a $9/month plan", "a checkout for this course" or "shipping labels for my orders", and Floot sets it up: subscriptions with a billing page, one-time payments, tickets and deposits, coupons and refunds, plus shipping with live rates, labels and tracking. Runs on Stripe, no API keys or webhooks. Test free in preview, go live when you publish.

title: Synter Canvas
description_en: Your AI agent runs ads across 30+ ad platforms. Your AI agent builds, launches and optimizes campaigns across 30+ ad platforms, with safety gates and guardrails on every change. $0.25 per verified write, 0% of ad spend.

title: Prelulu
description_en: Be the main character: chat & video roleplay any story. Immersive stories with AI characters you can text or video roleplay with. It's our first time bringing real-time avatar technology to consumer scale. You can create your own characters with live avatar capability.

title: OpenMail
description_en: Give your AI agents an identity through email. Your agents sign up for tools, receive verification codes and reply to customers, mostly from your Gmail or a shared sending pool where one bad actor gets everyone flagged. OpenMail gives every AI agent its own inbox on your domain with its own sending reputation, for one API call each. Incoming mail reaches your code over webhook or WebSocket, attachments arrive as text, and there's a hosted MCP server and a Hermes plugin. Built and hosted in the EU, free for 3 inboxes.

title: kosa8
description_en: Air-gapped microVM sandboxes for enterprise AI agents. kosa8 is security infrastructure for enterprise internal AI agents. Every agent gets its own microVM with its own kernel, on your Macs, your Linux servers, your cloud, or fully air-gapped. The agent sees one folder, API keys stay on the host (the sandbox holds a placeholder), and the network is closed except the hosts you allow. Rewind the whole machine in about a second when an agent gets it wrong. Docker-compatible, MCP-native, hash-chained audit, signed releases.

title: Videco
description_en: Turn every video into a content campaign with AI. Videco is an AI content studio and video hosting workspace for marketing teams. Find standout moments in demos and webinars, create branded short-form clips, and host, embed, and measure video in one place.

title: Orphex MCP
description_en: Run your entire digital marketing stack via one unified MCP. Orphex is the unified MCP gateway for digital marketing teams, handling auth and integrations for 65+ platforms, from Google Ads to Shopify, to give your AI true cross-channel context. Move your AI beyond QA: empower it to analyze integrated performance and take every action a human marketer can. Reallocate budgets, pause unprofitable creatives, or adjust products from a single prompt. Every change is logged and protected by safety guardrails. Start free, 30% off the first month.

title: Calendarly
description_en: Your calendar and tasks, right on your iPhone Lock Screen. Calendarly draws your calendar, reminders, Todoist tasks, notes and countdowns onto the iPhone Lock Screen wallpaper, and redraws it automatically through a Shortcuts automation.

title: Render Sandboxes
description_en: A computer for every agent. Render Sandboxes give every agent its own isolated Linux computer. Sandboxes starts in under a second and can run any agent or harness, like Claude Code or Codex. Your agent can also run your app with Docker Compose to test its changes. You decide which domains each sandbox can reach. When your agent goes idle, the sandbox suspends and compute charges stop. It wakes with files and memory intact. And you can reliably run thousands at once - all on the same platform as the rest of your app.

title: OpusClip 4.0
description_en: Turn raw footage into ready-to-publish videos with AI. OpusClip 4.0 goes beyond AI clipping to edit raw footage into finished videos. Automatically clean up speech, add captions and B-roll, create multiple formats, apply saved editing styles, and generate animated hooks and motion graphics.

title: LifeVal
description_en: OpenAI's benchmark for everyday life tasks with AI. LifeVal is OpenAI's new eval for the everyday tasks people most want help with, like finding childcare, budgeting, ordering groceries and government services. OpenAI says it used LifeVal for a year to push ChatGPT toward real agent work.

title: MachineMail
description_en: Email inboxes for humans and bots. Give your AI agents real inboxes to receive and send emails. Connect them over MCP or API, use your own domain, and get a trust report on every inbound message. Free includes 3,000 messages/month; paid plans start at $9/month.

title: Hookdeck Inspect
description_en: Free webhook tester for you and your agent. Test and debug webhooks with Hookdeck Inspect. Get a live URL you and your agent can use, plus mock webhooks for 500+ providers. It's free, no account or setup required.

title: People Search by Context.dev
description_en: People Search API: Find People by Role, Company & Location. Describe the people you need in plain English. Get up to 10 profiles per call with role, employer, location, experience, skills, and schools.

title: fileForensics
description_en: Real or not? Check files before your AI trusts them.. fileForensics is a trust check for every file your app or agent acts on. Extraction tells you what a document says; fileForensics tells you whether to believe it. It looks for signs of editing, AI-generated content, tampering and details that don’t add up, then returns findings with the evidence: what, where and why. No black-box score. All delivered in one call and works via API, MCP (Claude, Cursor, Codex), the developer portal and the fileAI platform. Check the file before you trust the data.

title: Prism
description_en: Cursor for hardware engineering. Prism is the AI platform for hardware engineering. CAD, physics solvers, 3D viewers, coding, and reporting together in one place, all driven by agents. Go from ideas to validated design effortlessly. Free to try on Windows, Mac and Linux.

title: Wavefunction
description_en: A minimal, open-source coding agent for your Mac. Coding agents keep turning into super apps. Wavefunction goes the other way: a minimal desktop app built for coding. Keep chatting while it works on several tasks in parallel. Use your ChatGPT subscription, Anthropic, Google, OpenRouter or a local model. Computer use runs on its own desktop, not yours. Free and open source.

title: KREV AI
description_en: An AI team that runs your ecommerce brand. KREV 2.0 is an AI team for your ecommerce brand. Scout tracks 10M+ competitor ads, Luna makes content that looks real, Kai buys your media, Chloe posts what's trending, Rue sends your emails, Toshi edits your store and Max gets you found.

title: Flockbay
description_en: Free AI game maker built on Godot. Flockbay is a free AI game maker built on Godot: an agent in the official Godot editor that writes GDScript and scenes, then playtests them. It runs the game, sends input events, reads the debugger and captures the viewport. Your game stays a plain Godot 4 project on disk. Start on free hosted AI, or bring your own Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, API key or MCP agent, or a local model on your GPU (Windows). Paid plans add Steam page drafts, trailers and devlogs. Godot 4.6+ on Windows, macOS, Linux.

title: Infino AI
description_en: Search, vectors and SQL over one Parquet copy, for agents. Infino is an open-source retrieval engine for AI agents. It keeps one copy of your data as Parquet on S3 or local disk, with BM25 and vector indexes inside the files. Agents run keyword, vector, hybrid and SQL search on it. Apache-2.0. Infino Cloud is generally available, with a free tier.

title: nana
description_en: One terminal for every coding agent, on Windows. Nana is a native terminal multiplexer for Windows. Run Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more side by side, each on its own git worktree. See who is working, waiting or done, review diffs, and keep agents running after you close the app. Free beta.

title: Dessn
description_en: The design canvas that runs your real code.. When product teams ship fast with AI, it's hard to keep track of what's live and keep it consistent. Dessn runs your codebase on a design canvas, always in sync with prod, so your team and agents work from one shared source of truth. • Audit your product and find inconsistencies • Map user flows with states and personas • Comment, branch and iterate together • Share prototypes for reviews, user tests or sales demos. Connect GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket in one click. Works with every tech stack.

title: kwant
description_en: AI bots that check each other's work before saying "done". Open-source AI team for your Mac, Linux or VPS. Hire bots from 27 roles; each message goes to the bot that fits, and you see why. Bots split work into cards, hand off and test each other, and a task turns Verified only when kwant checks it. Web facts come with links that open at the exact quote. Bots earn autonomy in Flight School, but payments always ask, and you choose which sites each bot may open. Runs on the Claude, Codex or Grok you already pay for.

title: Deployed Yet?
description_en: See if your Vercel, Cloudflare and GitHub deploys shipped. A free, open-source Mac menu bar app that answers one question: did it ship? Add as many Vercel, Cloudflare (Workers and Pages) and GitHub Actions accounts as you have, pick the projects to watch, and the menu bar shows ? while building, ✓ when it's live and ! when it broke. Get notified when a deploy fails or production goes live. Tokens stay in your Keychain and are only sent to the provider APIs.

title: One Roof
description_en: A new way to build with agents. You stay in charge.. One place for chorus coding: several sessions of Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Antigravity working together, with you in charge. Real terminals, one Inbox for everything they ask you, and a morning page that says what happened overnight. Free and open source.

title: Corvo
description_en: A mailbox that tidies itself as mail arrives. A new mailbox, not a Gmail wrapper. Codes show up ready to copy and auto-archive. One address per site — pause it if it leaks. Trackers removed, scams called out. Agents draft under your control. Nothing sends without you. Live on the App Store.

title: SUN Web & API
description_en: Turn prompts and PDFs into audio, on the web or via API. Meet the new SUN web experience and SUN API. Turn a prompt or PDF into podcasts, audio courses, audiobooks, stories, meditations, or music. Choose your voices, language, and length, explore public audio, and build audio generation into your own apps with the API.

title: Scrawl
description_en: Show your AI agent the problem with a visual frame. Scrawl records your screen, voice, clicks and drawings, then packs them into one compact capture you paste into your AI coding agent. Press ⌥⇧S, talk, click and draw. Frames are taken only when something happens, speech is transcribed on your Mac, and each frame is cropped to where you worked. Works with iPhone mirroring and ScrawlKit for iOS apps. Open source (MIT). macOS 15+, Apple silicon.

title: LiveReacting for ChatGPT
description_en: Run 24/7 and pre-recorded live streams from ChatGPT. LiveReacting is now a plugin in ChatGPT. Type @LiveReacting and ask. ChatGPT builds a looping playlist from your library and starts a 24/7 live stream, or schedules a recorded video to go live later. Stream to YouTube, Facebook, Twitch, LinkedIn, X or custom RTMP at once, change the playlist while live, and check status and viewers. We run the stream, so your computer can be off. Every paid plan includes the plugin.

title: Hira
description_en: Your free personal agent for job search. Applying to jobs is tedious and time-consuming. Stop applying manually and let Hira, your personalized AI agent, do everything for you. You can text it, connect it to Muse, or go through our website. All for free.

title: Zero Wire
description_en: Check your exposure to critical CVEs with one agent prompt . Zero Wire is a free vulnerability intelligence feed from Cloudflare Radar for security leads and engineers. Unlike CVE databases that list everything, it picks the critical issues in Internet-facing software and explains each in plain language: what's affected, who should check, and what to do now, with links to CVE records, vendor advisories and CISA KEV. Each briefing includes a ready prompt for your AI agent to run a read-only exposure check. No account needed.

title: Beamfy
description_en: AI vision assistant for blind people, live in 74 languages. Beamfy is an AI vision assistant for blind and low-vision people. Tap once and it describes what is in front of you as you walk, speaking only what changes, hazards first, until you stop it. It reads printed text aloud, tells you what you are holding, finds a place by voice with walking directions, and SOS texts your emergency contact with your location. Built for VoiceOver and TalkBack, in 74 languages. Photos are not stored. Free to start on iPhone and Android.

title: TrackEdge
description_en: Hidden AI buttons on your MacBook’s trackpad. TrackEdge turns the edges of a MacBook trackpad into controls. Slide along the right edge for volume, the left edge for display brightness, and the bottom edge for media playback. Double-tap either top corner to mute, open an app or website, press a keyboard shortcut, or run a Shortcuts action.

title: Oreja de Van Gogh
description_en:
pause Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks. A macOS menu bar app that pauses or lowers Apple Music while ChatGPT speaks, then returns it at the level and position you chose.

title: asklog
description_en: Give your coding agents a boss. Answer it from your phone.. Tell Chief one job. It splits it into tasks and starts Claude Code or Codex workers, each in its own copy of your repo, then brings you the decisions. Watch and answer from your phone, across your computers. Nothing merges without your authorization.

title: QualityLayer
description_en: Plan, build and review software with your coding agents. QualityLayer takes each code change through seven steps: Discuss, Research, Plan, Outline, Implement, Verify and Review. You comment on diagrams and clickable screens and approve the Plan before code changes. Your agent builds it test first, and a fresh agent that did not write the code checks the result against your request. It works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and four more on your own subscription, and runs on your computer. https://github.com/maxritter/qualitylayer

title: Hindsight Models and Inference API
description_en: Small, fast models for reranking, embeddings and decisions. Hosted models for the steps around your LLM: reranking, embeddings and typed decisions. Point your Cohere or OpenAI client at inference.hindsight.vectorize.io and keep your code. hs-rerank-1 and hs-embed-1 are the most accurate small open models on our benchmarks and run fast on a CPU; hs-decide-1-flash answers yes/no, pick-one and how-likely questions in 167 ms, instead of an LLM call. From $0.005 per 1M tokens, $5 free credit, open weights on Hugging Face.

title: NEXUPIRA
description_en: AI teammates that hand back finished work. Hire an AI team, not another chat box. Every WhatsApp customer message gets a reply drafted from your own documents, Rex prepares quotes as PDFs, Docu turns receipts and statements into Excel, and Nova keeps your calendar. Set routines that run on schedule. Connect Google Workspace and Notion free; Slack, GitHub and Linear on Pro. Work with your AI team from ChatGPT or Claude (Pro). You approve what goes out. Free to start, Pro US$15/mo.

title: PasteGuard for Mac
description_en: Keep secrets and personal data out of AI chats. PasteGuard masks API keys, passwords, emails, card numbers and more on your Mac's clipboard the moment you copy, so every paste into ChatGPT, Claude, Slack or a terminal is safe. An optional Apple Intelligence check on your Mac catches what rules miss. For what only you know, add custom rules, import CSV word lists or keep an Ignore list. Restore puts the real values back. No permissions, no account, nothing leaves your Mac.

title: Rungle
description_en: Turn your running photos and clips into share-ready Reels. Rungle is a free iPhone app that turns your runs into posts. Import distance, pace, heart rate and more from Apple Health (or a screenshot of your running app) and put them on your photos with stylish overlays. AI best cuts picks shots worth sharing, and Reel templates like KM Splits and Spider Shot come with filming guides. Running Courses helps you find your next route on a map. Keep your running app. Rungle handles the edit.

title: Eyecon
description_en: Auto pause video when you look away. Eyecon pauses the video when you stop looking at the screen, and starts it again when you look back. Someone talks to you. You reach for something. You fall asleep. The video keeps playing, you miss a few minutes, and then you drag the progress bar around hunting for the spot where you left off. Eyecon removes that whole loop. The front camera checks one thing: whether your eyes are on the screen. When they are not, Eyecon sends a pause to whatever app is playing.

title: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
description_en: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
